title: Foreman-E Worker Pool
description: Foreman-E coordinates workers 081-100 as one aggregated pool. The room shows pool summaries plus only important worker exceptions.

messages.text: Workers 081-100 handle staging, temporary access, path markers, and diff collection. Every temporary block must carry a tmp/* tag.
messages.systemLog: foreman-e INFO assign packet=E staging=6 scaffold=8 cleanup=6 workers=20 temp_tag_prefix=tmp/

messages.text: The pool repeated safe straight-line placement enough times to publish place_line with bounds, air_check, and rollback guards.
messages.systemLog: run-monitor INFO skill-cache append logs/skills.jsonl name=place_line samples=18 guards=bounds,air_check,rollback

messages.text: Temporary access blocks are indexed by tag: tmp/scaffold/main-01 and tmp/path/main-03. Cleanup can be deterministic during verification.
Pool E complete. All diff shards are collected, temporary tag ledger is closed, and final cleanup has zero unknown temporary blocks.
messages.systemLog: foreman-e INFO packet=E complete workers=20 temp=31 diff_shards=5 remaining_tmp_unknown=0
